headline: MPs Urge Government Protection for Poundland Amid Collapse Risks
summary: Members of parliament called on the UK government to protect budget retailer Poundland from asset-stripping after it filed a notice to appoint administrators, threatening 12,000 jobs.
why: Retail insolvencies disrupt employment markets, commercial landlord revenues, and high street supply chains, drawing direct political and regulatory intervention.

impacts.name: UK retail sector
impacts.why: The potential collapse of a major high street chain affects retail property and employment.
